schema.text: What would make you use public transport more? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Real-time arrival information, on screens and announced
Step-free stops and vehicles (working lifts, ramps)
Well-lit stops with staff or cameras
Stops with seats and shelter from sun and rain

it.#What would make you use public transpor: Cosa ti farebbe usare di più i mezzi pubblici? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#More frequent and reliable services: Un servizio più frequente e affidabile
it.#Real-time arrival information, on scree: Informazioni sugli arrivi in tempo reale, sugli schermi e con annunci
it.#Step-free stops and vehicles (working l: Fermate e veicoli senza gradini (ascensori funzionanti, rampe)
it.#Safer crossings near stops: Attraversamenti più sicuri vicino alle fermate
it.#Well-lit stops with staff or cameras: Fermate ben illuminate, con personale o telecamere
it.#Stops with seats and shelter from sun a: Fermate con sedili e riparo da sole e pioggia

fr.#What would make you use public transpor: Qu’est-ce qui vous ferait utiliser davantage les transports en commun ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#More frequent and reliable services: Des services plus fréquents et plus fiables
fr.#Real-time arrival information, on scree: Une information en temps réel sur les arrivées, à l’écran et par annonce
fr.#Step-free stops and vehicles (working l: Des arrêts et des véhicules sans marches (ascenseurs en état de marche, rampes)
fr.#Safer crossings near stops: Des traversées plus sûres près des arrêts
fr.#Well-lit stops with staff or cameras: Des arrêts bien éclairés, avec du personnel ou des caméras
fr.#Stops with seats and shelter from sun a: Des arrêts avec des places assises et un abri contre le soleil et la pluie

de.#What would make you use public transpor: Was würde dazu führen, dass Sie öffentliche Verkehrsmittel öfter nutzen? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#Real-time arrival information, on scree: Ankunftsinformationen in Echtzeit, auf Anzeigen und per Durchsage
de.#Step-free stops and vehicles (working l: Stufenlos zugängliche Haltestellen und Fahrzeuge (funktionierende Aufzüge, Rampen)
de.#Safer crossings near stops: Sicherere Überwege in der Nähe der Haltestellen
de.#Well-lit stops with staff or cameras: Gut beleuchtete Haltestellen mit Personal oder Kameras
de.#Stops with seats and shelter from sun a: Haltestellen mit Sitzplätzen und Schutz vor Sonne und Regen

tr.#What would make you use public transpor: Toplu taşımayı daha çok kullanmanızı neler sağlar? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Real-time arrival information, on scree: Ekranlarda ve anonsla verilen anlık varış bilgisi
tr.#Step-free stops and vehicles (working l: Basamaksız duraklar ve araçlar (çalışan asansörler, rampalar)
tr.#Safer crossings near stops: Duraklara yakın daha güvenli yaya geçitleri
tr.#Well-lit stops with staff or cameras: İyi aydınlatılmış, görevli veya kameralı duraklar
tr.#Stops with seats and shelter from sun a: Oturacak yeri olan, güneşten ve yağmurdan korunaklı duraklar

fa.#Real-time arrival information, on scree: اطلاعات لحظه‌ای زمان رسیدن، روی نمایشگر و با اعلام صوتی
fa.#Step-free stops and vehicles (working l: ایستگاه‌ها و وسایل نقلیه بدون پله (آسانسور و رمپ سالم)
fa.#Well-lit stops with staff or cameras: ایستگاه‌های پرنور با کارکنان یا دوربین
fa.#Stops with seats and shelter from sun a: ایستگاه‌هایی با صندلی و پناهگاه در برابر آفتاب و باران

hu.#What would make you use public transpor: Mitől használná gyakrabban a tömegközlekedést? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#Real-time arrival information, on scree: Valós idejű érkezési tájékoztatás kijelzőkön és hangosbemondással

hu.#Well-lit stops with staff or cameras: Jól megvilágított megállók személyzettel vagy kamerákkal
hu.#Stops with seats and shelter from sun a: Ülőhelyek, valamint nap és eső elleni védelem a megállókban

ar.#Step-free stops and vehicles (working l: محطات ومركبات بلا درجات (مصاعد ومنحدرات تعمل)

ar.#Stops with seats and shelter from sun a: محطات فيها مقاعد ومظلات تقي من الشمس والمطر
